description: This file defines request handlers for 'tools.effective' API, including functions to resolve agent IDs, session contexts, and respond with effective tool inventory based on session and configuration data.

methods.name: resolveRequestedAgentIdOrRespondError
methods.description: Resolves the requested agent ID from parameters, responds with an error if unknown.

methods.name: resolveTrustedToolsEffectiveContext
methods.description: Resolves session and context information for tools effective request, validating session key and agent ID.
